title: Discovery of novel N-sulfonamide-tetrahydroisoquinolines as potent retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gammat agonists.
authors: Ma, Xiaojun; Sun, Nannan; Li, Xinwei; Fu, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子RORgammat激动剂的发现与分子动力学模拟，对象为核受体-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或结合建模方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cancer immunotherapy has become a research hotspot in recent years. A variety of targets were developed for small molecule immuno-oncology agents, including retinoic acid-related orphan receptor gamma t (RORgammat), chemokine receptor, stimulator of interferon genes (Sting), indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO), toll-like receptors (TLR), etc. Among them, the retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gammat (RORgammat) has gradually attracted more attention in these years. In particular, LYC-55716 (cintirorgon), a small molecule RORgammat agonist developed by Lycera, has entered the phase II clinical study. In this work, starting from compound 7, compound 28 was obtained after 4 rounds of compound design, synthesis and SAR studies, which had an EC(50) of 0.021 +/- 0.002 muM in dual Fluorescence Resonance Energy Transfer (dual-FRET) assay and an EC(50) of 0.021 +/- 0.002 muM in mouse Th17 cell differentiation assay. It indicated that compound 28 had excellent RORgammat agonistic activity and was expected to be developed as a new type of small molecule drug for cancer immunotherapy. The molecular dynamic simulation revealed that the agonist 28 formed a strong HYF triplet intramolecular interaction to stabilize H12, which helped RORgammat to form the protein-binding site and therefore made the receptor ready to recruit coactivator. When the inverse agonist s27 bound with RORgammat, the steric hindrance between s27 and H479 caused the destruction of the HYF triplet, leading to the collapse of H12, thus the transcription function of RORgammat was interrupted due to the failure of recruiting a coactivator molecule. The triplet HYF in RORgammat and the rigidity of 28 and s27 were identified to be the structural determinants for the functional switch of RORgammat.
abstract_zh: 癌症免疫治疗近年来已成为研究热点。针对小分子免疫肿瘤药物，已开发出多种靶点，包括维甲酸相关孤儿受体γt（RORgammat）、趋化因子受体、干扰素基因刺激因子（Sting）、吲哚胺2,3-双加氧酶（IDO）、Toll样受体（TLR）等。其中，维甲酸受体相关孤儿受体γt（RORgammat）近年来逐渐受到更多关注。特别是，由Lycera公司开发的小分子RORgammat激动剂LYC-55716（cintirorgon）已进入II期临床研究。在本工作中，从化合物7出发，经过4轮化合物设计、合成及构效关系（SAR）研究，获得了化合物28，其在双荧光共振能量转移（dual-FRET）实验中EC(50)为0.021 ± 0.002 μM，在小鼠Th17细胞分化实验中EC(50)为0.021 ± 0.002 μM。这表明化合物28具有优异的RORgammat激动活性，有望被开发为新型小分子癌症免疫治疗药物。分子动力学模拟揭示，激动剂28通过形成强HYF三联体分子内相互作用来稳定H12，这有助于RORgammat形成蛋白结合位点，从而使受体准备好招募共激活因子。当反向激动剂s27与RORgammat结合时，s27与H479之间的空间位阻导致HYF三联体破坏，引起H12塌陷，从而因无法招募共激活因子分子而中断RORgammat的转录功能。RORgammat中的HYF三联体以及28和s27的刚性被确定为RORgammat功能开关的结构决定因素。
